content_fields.title: Verify that TLS authentication is configured for the Docker daemon (Docker)
content_fields.description: Verify that TLS client authentication is configured for the Docker daemon.
content_fields.guidance: Verification means confirming the daemon listens only on a TLS socket with client certificate verification enabled, and that an unauthenticated connection to the daemon is refused.
content_fields.found: The scripts talk to the daemon over the local socket; daemon TLS settings are not represented in the repository.
content_fields.missing: Access to the daemon's configuration and its certificate material.
content_fields.conclusion: Daemon TLS is host configuration outside this repository's control.
content_fields.action: The platform team should verify daemon TLS configuration on each container host.
